course.title: Transport Phenomena in Materials
course.department: Department of Materials Science and Engineering

content.value: The viscosity of a fluid is to be measured by a viscometer constructed of two 40 cm long (10) concentric cylinders. The outer diameter of the inner cylinder is 14 cm, and the gap between the two cylinders is 0.13 cm. The inner cylinder is rotated at 320 rpm, and the torque is measured to be 1.9 N.m. Determine the viscosity of the fluid.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 3rd Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2022
